How corrupt @dominionvoting has been stealing our elections: read all 31 pages of the sworn testimony of one Venezuelan whistleblower. Link below. 

SURPRISE ENDING 

The transcript has been filed in federal District Court - Colorado.  

Votes can be flipped, injected, deleted without a trace! The Philippines also caught corrupt Dominion Voting stealing their elections. 

Dozens of other countries' elections have been stolen also. We have to stop saying "well, they voted for what they are now getting".  No, not accurate! 

Citizens have not been voting for the garbage politicians now leading their countries, such as Canada, the United Kingdom, Ukraine and many other places - 

their elections have been stolen from them!  Just like ours from us. By Dominion, by ES&S, by HART Civic and the other corrupt voting companies. Based on the software/firmware of Smartmatic, Sequoia, Vista. 

Over a dozen whistleblowers have flipped now, from Serbia and Venezuela.  

I want to call out Heider Garcia in particular: this August he resigned as Dallas County election chief. He was a key figure in the corrupt elections getting Hugo Chavez/Maduro in power turning Venezuela into a state drug cartel enterprise. Guess where he is now (below).

This is exactly why some of the very first arrests by the US DOJ targeted the Tren de Aragua gang. Cells of them were placed here to cause mayhem in the USA.

All the above is why President Trump has the US Navy offshore from Venezuela right now - and pray he soon gives orders to wipe out Maduro and minions.

Then there is Ron Morales, another Venezuelan who helped Maduro steal elections, turning that country into a hell hole. Guess who he works for? Dominion Voting Company Senior Systems Manager!!

He is at the McKinney, Texas facility where they install the software/firmware into the tabulators and EMS (computer servers located at county level). How convenient. 

I did a long post on Ron Morales: see it at June 25, 2025. Below however, look at the @SheriffLeaf letter on Morales.

https://t.co/LYZb22DbLc
